name: Keep
description: Open-source alerting and AIOps platform that correlates alerts from monitoring tools into unified incidents.

envVars.description: Authentication mode for the Keep UI and API

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      API_URL: "http://{{serviceName}}-api:8080"
      AUTH_TYPE: {{env.AUTH_TYPE}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/state:/state
  {{serviceName}}-api:
    image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/keephq/keep/keep-api:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-api
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      AUTH_TYPE: NO_AUTH
